name: @titon-network/automaton
description: Production-ready off-chain automaton node for the Titon protocol suite (Kronos automation, Fortuna VRF, Themis sealed-bid threshold-decryption, Phoebe price oracle). Stake once with ForgeTON, earn across every admitted consumer product. Built on TSA-audited SDKs (forgeton, atlas, kronos, fortuna — zero findings each).

scripts.smoke: node dist/cli/index.js --version && node dist/cli/index.js doctor && node dist/cli/index.js playground --ticks 1 --tick-interval 0 --no-fortuna --json > /dev/null
scripts.verify: pnpm run build && pnpm run test && pnpm run smoke
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm run clean && pnpm run build && chmod +x dist/cli/index.js && node scripts/check-shebang.mjs
scripts.sync:sdks: cd ../forgeton/sdks/typescript && pnpm run build && cd ../../../kronos/sdks/typescript && pnpm run build && cd ../../../atlas/sdks/typescript && pnpm run build && cd ../../../fortuna/sdks/typescript && pnpm run build && cd ../../../themis/sdks/typescript && pnpm run build && cd ../../../phoebe/sdks/typescript && pnpm run build && cd ../../../automaton && pnpm install --force
